Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, rain clouds, rainbows or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Camille from League of Legends — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a cropped top and a micro skirt or hot pants that bare the midriff, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.

EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it; only the costume's own pieces.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
